description: Detects smurfing patterns by identifying accounts that split large transactions into multiple smaller ones to evade detection thresholds.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-* | WHERE event.type == "credit" AND event.amount > 0 AND event.amount < 3000 AND DATE_DIFF("days", transaction.date, NOW()) <= ?days | STATS small_deposits = COUNT(*), total_aggregated = SUM(event.amount), avg_deposit = AVG(event.amount) BY account.name | WHERE small_deposits >= 5 | SORT small_deposits DESC | LIMIT 50
